title: The Future of God of War | Laufey, Trilogy Remake, Sons of Sparta and the TV Show
description: Everything confirmed about the future of God of War: God of War Laufey (February 16, 2027, PS5), its story, gameplay and cast, the Greek Trilogy Remake, Sons of Sparta, and Amazon's God of War TV series starring Dave Bautista as Kratos.
tags: God of War Sons of Sparta

thumbnail.text: THE FUTURE OF GOD OF WAR

sections.heading: A huge time for God of War
sections.script: Twenty twenty six has been one of the biggest years ever for God of War. In just a few months, Sony surprise launched a brand new 2D game, announced a remake of the original Greek trilogy, revealed a new main game starring Faye, and Amazon's live action TV series found a new Kratos. In this video we go through everything that has actually been confirmed: release dates, platforms, story, gameplay, cast and what we still do not know. No leaks and no rumours, only official information. Let's start with the game everyone is talking about.

sections.heading: God of War Laufey revealed
sections.script: God of War Laufey was revealed at Sony's State of Play on June second, twenty twenty six, with a twenty minute gameplay trailer that closed the show. It is the eleventh game in the series, developed by Santa Monica Studio and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment. The game director is Ariel Lawrence, and Bear McCreary, who composed the music for God of War twenty eighteen, Ragnarok and Sons of Sparta, is back for the soundtrack. God of War Laufey launches on February sixteenth, twenty twenty seven, on PlayStation 5. Pre-orders for the physical and digital versions opened on September twenty ninth, twenty twenty six. And there is good news for collectors: even though Sony has said it will move away from physical discs in the future, Santa Monica Studio confirmed that Laufey will be released on disc.

sections.heading: Who is Faye
sections.script: The big change is the hero. For the first time in a main God of War game, you do not play as Kratos. You play as Laufey, better known as Faye. Faye was a Jotnar, one of the giants, and a warrior known as the Golden Hand. She was once the guardian of the giants and a rebel leader called Laufey the Just. She was also Kratos' wife and the mother of Atreus, and her death is the event that starts God of War twenty eighteen. Deborah Ann Woll, who voiced Faye in Ragnarok, returns to play her in Laufey. Series creative director Cory Barlog has reportedly wanted to tell Faye's story since twenty eighteen, and he pitched it to Woll when she first joined Ragnarok.

sections.heading: The story and the Everywhen
sections.script: So how can a game star a character who is already dead? Laufey's story begins after Faye's funeral. She wakes up in a place called the Everywhen, a realm where magic comes from and where gods from different mythologies go after they die. Something is wrong there: the natural flow of magic has been disrupted. Faye discovers that the plans she left behind to protect Kratos and Atreus are in danger, and protecting them becomes her mission. Her adventure happens at the same time as the events of God of War twenty eighteen and Ragnarok. And for the first time, the series adds Egyptian and Mongolian mythology alongside its Norse roots, which opens the door to brand new gods, monsters and worlds.

sections.heading: Gameplay: how Faye fights
sections.script: Laufey's combat builds on God of War twenty eighteen and Ragnarok, but Faye plays very differently from Kratos. She is much more mobile, and she can switch between ground attacks and aerial attacks without breaking her combo. Her main weapon is a sword guarded by Rue, an enchanted ribbon that is also a character in the story. The combat focuses on speed, control and chaining attacks together. Her most unusual power is her golden palm. With it, Faye can separate an enemy's soul from its body. Then she can attack the soul directly, or knock it into other enemies to create combos and hit whole groups at once. Based on the gameplay reveal, it looks faster and more acrobatic than anything Kratos has done.

sections.heading: The cast and the villains
sections.script: Laufey has a strong cast. Jack Quaid, known for The Boys, voices Phranque, a curious cosmic cube who cannot remember his past and becomes one of Faye's companions. Perlina Lau voices Rue, the enchanted ribbon. And yes, Kratos is in the game. Christopher Judge returns as Kratos, this time as a non-playable character. The villains are gods of war from other mythologies: Sekhmet, the Egyptian goddess of war, and Begtse, the Mongolian god of war. A game about one God of War's wife, fighting other gods of war, is a really clever idea for this series.

sections.heading: Editions and pre-order bonuses
sections.script: If you pre-order a physical copy of Laufey, you get the Last Wish armor set for Faye, a Golden Leaves look for Phranque, and an in-game resource pack. The Digital Deluxe Edition includes the Dark Alchemy armor set, with a matching blade, bow scales and catalyst, plus a resource pack, a digital mini artbook and a digital copy of the official soundtrack. At the moment Laufey is announced for PlayStation 5 only. Earlier God of War games did come to PC later, God of War twenty eighteen in January twenty twenty two and Ragnarok in September twenty twenty four, but there is no official PC announcement for Laufey yet.

sections.heading: Sons of Sparta
sections.script: Laufey was not the only God of War surprise this year. On February twelfth, twenty twenty six, at the end of a State of Play, Sony shadow dropped God of War Sons of Sparta on PlayStation 5. It is a 2D, Metroidvania style side scroller about Kratos' youth in Sparta, developed by Mega Cat Studios in partnership with Santa Monica Studio. Bear McCreary composed the music, and reviewers loved the soundtrack. Reviews overall were mixed to positive. Some critics felt the pacing was slow, but many fans enjoyed seeing a younger Kratos, long before the gods made his life a nightmare.

sections.heading: The Greek Trilogy Remake
sections.script: At that same February State of Play, Sony announced the God of War Trilogy Remake, which will remake the original God of War, God of War Two and God of War Three. Only a logo was shown, with no gameplay and no release date. Santa Monica Studio said the project is in early development and that it will be some time before more updates. The best news for long time fans: TC Carson, the original voice of Kratos in the Greek games, has confirmed he is involved. With modern graphics, the battles against Ares, Zeus and the Titans could look more incredible than ever.

sections.heading: The God of War TV series
sections.script: God of War is also coming to TV. Amazon's live action series for Prime Video has Ronald D Moore as showrunner, and Amazon has ordered two seasons. Filming began in Vancouver in February twenty twenty six, with Ryan Hurst as Kratos. But in late June, Hurst tore his bicep while filming a stunt, production was paused, and on August twentieth, twenty twenty six, Dave Bautista was confirmed as the new Kratos. Callum Vinson plays Atreus in season one. The cast also includes Mandy Patinkin as Odin, Ed Skrein as Baldur, Ólafur Darri Ólafsson as Thor, Max Parker as Heimdall, Teresa Palmer as Sif and Alastair Duncan as Mimir. Scenes with Hurst will be reshot, and there is no premiere date yet.

sections.heading: What we still don't know
sections.script: So what is still a mystery? We do not know if Laufey will come to PC, or how big the Everywhen will be. We do not know when the Trilogy Remake will launch, or when the TV series will premiere. And while Kratos is in Laufey, we do not know yet what his next playable adventure will be. But one thing is clear: God of War has never been bigger. Are you excited to play as Faye on February sixteenth? Let us know in the comments, and subscribe to HarryBeast Gaming so you do not miss any God of War news.
